what: What the design site's Vehicles review page shows for this car (R126). tools/vehicles/review/build.mjs turns this, vehicle.json, the bake and assets/profiles/<id>.json into art/ui/poc/vehicles/<id>/; tools/vehicles/review/check.mjs fails if any Vehicles-contract item is missing. name: Tradie Ute
summary: Owner-evidence rebuild: separate thin alloy flat tray, closed black TC-style canopy (no rear glazing or invented vents), horizontal amber/red/white tray lamps, checker guards and mudflaps, under-tray boxes and tow ball. The dual cab now follows the newer owner-model rake and narrower tapered roof; roof rack, left awning and right snorkel remain recognizable. Tray/canopy dimensions use the owner tape measurements of 2026-10-21. Existing wheel pivots, collider hull, anchors and handling are frozen. Cab/front styling remains a faceted interpretation, not a scan. LOD0/1/2 qualified budgets remain 2400/900/600; measured totals are recorded in validation.md.
feedback: Comment on this page (what to change, which view or state); the session turns each comment into a bug bead that cites this page and the car's id.

reference.note: Authoritative real night photos and owner tape dimensions supersede the earlier Muse sheet, whose score only measures resemblance to a generated composite. See refs/measured-reference.json, measured-check.json and the validation report. Real photos are perspective, occluded and uncalibrated: no photo silhouette IoU is claimed.

damage.note: Left to right: intact; door_FL and door_RL loose; front and back loose; wheel_FL cambered; front detached; door_FL detached; back (tray and canopy) detached; wheel_FL detached; both front doors and the tray detached; a stripped shell. Posed in a three.js viewer about each part's hinge line; the host renderer cannot draw a second vehicle yet.
